messages:
devin: PR ready for review but blocked on arch sign-off. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/7890

aj: pinging arch team — this changes model routing + cache behavior, right?

devin: yep. high level: add route-level fallback to smaller-quantized variant + new `kv_cache_ttl` config.

maria: can you drop the RFC link here? need to see design. :eyes: 

devin: RFC: https://redwood-inference.internal/rfcs/2026-03-routing-cache.md

sam: quick skim — where are perf numbers for 2k token tails? also eviction semantics

devin: perf: median p95 latency before: 180ms, after: 200ms; throughput +8% at 1k batch. KV eviction: LRU per-model, TTL default 6h. snippet:

```
routes:
  - model: gpt-xx
    fallback: gpt-xx-8q
    kv_cache_ttl: 21600 # seconds
```

lia: security check: any new plaintext keys or network changes for Private? If not, ok from sec side.

devin: no new keys; uses existing KMS flow. Private customer noted in RFC, see section 4.

aj: ci-bot ran tests but one integration failed: `routing.integration_test::fallbacks` — looks flakey, can you fix or add a TODO?

ci-bot: automatic note — failing test attached: /artifacts/7890/fallback.log

devin: already pushed a fix, rerunning. will hold merge until arch ACK. if arch OK, i'll wait 30min for any last comments then merge + canary.

maria: reviewing now, focusing on failure modes and fallback correctness. expect decision in ~1h.

sam: quick Q — are rollouts gated by model version pin? need to ensure canary uses v2 only.

devin: yes, canary pin added in deployment config. will include rollout plan in PR description.

maria: ack from arch: design looks OK, minor nits in RFC comments. Please address the RFC comments, run the flaky test twice, then I'll +1.

devin: thanks — addressing nits now. will ping when tests pass. :thumbsup:
